pr_body:
This PR adds a new endpoint under `_info/http`. This endpoint summarises the HTTP stats of all the nodes into one big response, at cluster level. Compared with `_nodes/_stats`, it lacks the `nodes` dimension. 

## Response example:
```json
{
  "cluster_name": "runTask",
  "http": {
    "current_open": 1,
    "total_opened": 53,
    "clients": [
      {
        "id": 1556275969,
        "local_address": "127.0.0.1:9200",
        "remote_address": "127.0.0.1:50883",
        "last_uri": "/_http_stats",
        "opened_time_millis": 1684319173046,
        "closed_time_millis": 1684319173046,
        "last_request_time_millis": 1684319173046,
        "request_count": 1,
        "request_size_bytes": 0
      },
      {
        "id": 414091317,
        "local_address": "127.0.0.1:9200",
        "remote_address": "127.0.0.1:50884",
        "last_uri": "/_http_stats",
        "opened_time_millis": 1684319173855,
        "closed_time_millis": 1684319173855,
        "last_request_time_millis": 1684319173855,
        "request_count": 1,
        "request_size_bytes": 0
      },
...
    ]
  }
}
```

It also introduces a new `AbstractInfoAction` class which will be used to implement the next work about [the extraction of stats](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+extract+author%3Adakrone)

Closes #95391
